records.text: Geenia Sunshadow is a specialty dress maker in the tailoring trade. She offers goods and can help with quests.
Darnall sells tailoring supplies.
Sindrayl is a hippogryph flight master who can arrange air travel. She calls for the guards when threatened.
Celes Earthborne is a quest-giver.
A humanoid named Mylentha Riverbend in Moonglade.
A humanoid named Bessany Plainswind in Moonglade.
A humanoid named Moren Riverbend in Moonglade.

Bunthen Plainswind is Thunder Bluff's flight master. He arranges flights to Thunder Bluff and directs travelers seeking a return to Rut'theran Village to his night elven counterpart, Silva Fil'naveth.

Tajarri is a trusted warden of Moonglade's Shrine of Remulos and treats its sanctity as her charge, warning visitors to behave. She oversees druids' lake trial and explains the shrine's place in the Cenarion Circle; her work also includes the sea-lion aquatic-form trial.
Silva Fil'naveth is a Darnassus flight master who offers passage to Rut'theran Village on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. Visitors can also ask her about the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility.

Rabine Saturna welcomes aid for the Cenarion Circle and says its cooperation serves Azeroth's preservation. They suspect a renewed threat in Silithus, where they believe a Reliquary of Purity may remain among Southwind's ruins. They seek it to contain Felvine from Dire Maul and calls for help against that danger.

Dendrite Starblaze guides young druids in Nighthaven, welcoming respect for nature while insisting on balance and peace. Pupils are sent to the Great Bear Spirit for understanding. Dendrite teaches that aquatic form must be earned through agility, endurance and embracing the sea lion's aspect, referring learners to Turak Runetotem for final training in Thunder Bluff.
Moonglade wardens maintain peace, trained to stop hostilities without hesitation.

Keeper Remulos is a keeper of the Emerald Dream who works to confront the Nightmare with restraint. He studies collected fragments to locate its source and plans to draw Eranikus into the waking world for redemption, coordinating the effort to protect Nighthaven while Tyrande comes to help. Remulos can send people into the Dream to recover magically restorative acorns, though he warns that the dangerous passage may expose them to nightmares. He is also concerned for those who have given up their waking lives to save Azeroth. When Malfurion returns, Remulos asks after his father and brother, reflecting his concern for their family and the fragile peace among Azeroth’s peoples.

Umber is the Cenarion Circle’s archivist, skilled at salvaging damaged tomes. His work includes examining an encrusted Silithid object from Silithus; he describes its recovered contents as an ancient Darnassian journal valuable to the Circle. He speaks in a playful, digressive way, cheerfully correcting himself and teasing visitors about their smell.
Great Bear Spirit is a bear-shaped spiritual presence associated with a question about what it represents. It is calm and patient, saying nothing.
Great Cat Spirit is a great-cat spiritual presence.
Dargon is a food and drink merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Daeolyn Summerleaf is a general goods merchant who offers goods for browsing.
Lorelae Wintersong is a trade supplies merchant. Her listed services include browsing her goods, alongside her questgiver role.
Kharedon is a light armor merchant who offers goods and repairs equipment. His listed services make him a practical contact for armor and gear upkeep.
Meliri is a weaponsmith who offers weapons and equipment repairs, combining a specialist arms trade with a practical repair service.
Malvor is an herbalism trainer. His listed training services also include options concerning talent specialization and unlearning talents or a pet's skills.
My'lanna is a food and drink merchant, offering provisions for travelers. Her listed services also include browsing her goods and quest assistance.
Narianna is a bowyer who offers bows and related goods, as well as equipment repairs. Her services pair a specialist ranged-weapon trade with gear upkeep.

Loganaar is a druid trainer who welcomes trainees as siblings and offers to guide their training. He describes deeper druidic mastery as a later calling in the Emerald Dream, where druids hibernate for years and walk among its purest forms. His counsel also looks inward: tranquility and balance can be found even within the town's cold stone walls.
Faustron serves as a wind rider master in the Barrens and offers travelers fast flight.

Valadar Starsong hosts the Lunar Festival in Nighthaven and collects Coins of Ancestry, which he exchanges for festival gifts. He welcomes visitors to the normally remote village during the celebration, explaining that it opens itself to outsiders then. His sister Fariel shares that welcome. Valadar presents honoring elders as respect for culture and tradition, and offers Elune's candle with his blessing to those who bring ancestral coins.
Lunar Festival Vendors offer goods for visitors to browse during the Lunar Festival. The same familiar vendor role appears in many regions.
Fariel Starsong is a Coin of Ancestry Collector who says that, like a brother, Fariel honors those who honor their ancestors and takes joy in sharing crafting secrets with Lunar Festival disciples.
Lunar Festival Sentinels are elite humanoid guards stationed around festival grounds in several areas.

Clintar Dreamwalker is a druid who feels trapped in an alien, dangerous Emerald Dream. He fears pursuers and struggles to recognize waking surroundings, initially treating strangers as intruders in Ysera’s realm. Unable to withdraw fully, he offers a fragile fragment of his spirit to guide the search for Aviana’s relics.
A Cenarion dreamwarden belonging to the wardens who watch over Clintar Dreamwalker during his immersion in the Emerald Dream.

Dreamwarden Lurosa urges haste because escaping creatures threaten more than Clintar Dreamwalker. Lurosa admires his strength in sustaining a divided essence while under attack, wants Aviana’s relics guarded, and asks that Morthis help identify the force invading the Emerald Dream.
Manifest Nightmare appears in Moonglade.
Phantasmal Lash is a named presence in Moonglade.

Clintar Dreamwalker's Spirit is a fragile fragment of Clintar, sent from the Emerald Dream to guide a search for the Relics of Aviana. It entrusts the relics to the player to carry to Morthis Whisperwing, then returns completely to the Dream. Clintar describes the spirit as fearful and vulnerable, and the Dream as alien and dangerous.
A Nightmare Aberration elemental found in Moonglade.
A Nightmare Figment in Moonglade.
